canonical.title: Rotate array left&right by k places

narrative.title: Cyclic Duty Roster
narrative.scenario: An on-call roster is stored as an ordered list of engineers, and every k weeks the schedule is cycled so later engineers take the earliest shifts. Ops needs both directions available: one helper cycles the roster to the right, the other to the left. Both must rearrange the roster in place without a scratch copy.
narrative.inputFormat: An array arr of n integer ids followed by a non-negative integer k, the number of positions to cycle.
narrative.outputFormat: The array cycled k positions in the requested direction; a right rotation by k moves the last k entries to the front.

testCases.explanation: Cycling right three times lifts the tail block 5,6,7 to the front while the rest keeps its order.
Two right shifts move the last pair to the front, and ordering inside each block is preserved.

hintLevels: Level 1: Shifting one slot at a time costs k full passes; try to reach the answer with a constant number of passes instead.
Level 2: Splitting the roster into two blocks and reversing each block separately, then reversing the whole roster, lands exactly on the rotated order.
Level 3: k can exceed n, so reduce it modulo n first; otherwise the block split falls outside the array.
